text:
Ivy W: FYI support flagged a tenant who sent mixed 128/1024 dim embeds and got throttled despite Console showing low units.
Tom H: Is this the avg-vs-max problem again?
Ivy W: Looks like it. Console used avg heuristic for UX. Runtime charges by max dim after packing.
Renee (console): We should not silently change numbers. Proposal: show conservative estimate (max-dim) + optional 'run preflight' button that calls router's estimator.
Tom H: Preflight adds load; make it opt-in and rate-limited per-tenant. Also cache results for 5m keyed by dims vector.
Renee (console): Agreed. UX: banner: "Mixed sizes detected. Click 'Get estimate' for authoritative units."
Tom H: Telemetry: emit embed.estimate_requested and embed.estimate_discrepancy histogram. Alert if >3% tenants see >2x discrepancy.
Ivy W: Add support FAQ and notify affected tenants. We should also add SDK helper to call preflight before big batches.
metrics-bot: rollout scheduled: console/preflight-button -> canary -> 2026-04-05T10:00Z
Renee (console): I'll own the PR for the button and copy. Tom, please draft the preflight API spec.
Tom H: Will do.
